simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to צָעִיף (H6809) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: צָעִיף (tsâʻîyph) means a veil First listed occurrence: Gen 24 65.

definitions.full: H6809. tsaiph צָעִיף noun [masculine] wrapper, shawl, or veil ; — absolute ׳צ Gen 24:65 ; 38:14 ; suffix צְעִיפָהּ 38:19 (all J). צַעֲצֻעִים see צוע .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to wrap over ;
